data.name: LibraryImportVmTip
data.value: Import a VMware (.vmx) or VirtualBox (.vbox) machine, an OVF package (.ova, .ovf) or a Hyper-V disk (.vhdx)

data.name: LibraryRefreshTip
data.value: Detect QEMU again and rescan the library

data.name: LibraryEmpty
data.value: No virtual machines. Use + to create one.

data.name: ToolbarPauseTip
data.value: Freezes the machine without shutting it down, or resumes it exactly where it left off

data.name: ToolbarShutDownTip
data.value: Asks the guest operating system to shut down cleanly (ACPI power button)

data.name: ToolbarPowerOffTip
data.value: Turns the machine off immediately, without warning the guest, like pulling the plug. Use Shut down for a clean shutdown.

data.name: ToolbarCtrlAltDelTip
data.value: Windows intercepts this key combination: it can only be sent to the guest from here

data.name: ToolbarUsbTip
data.value: Connects a USB device of this PC to the running machine, or chooses the ones to connect at every start

data.name: ToolbarSoundTip
data.value: Mutes this machine or sets its volume on this PC

data.name: ToolbarPullFilesTip
data.value: Copies files or folders from the guest to this PC

data.name: ToolbarSendFilesTip
data.value: Copies files from this PC to the guest's desktop. You can also drag them onto the console, folders included.

data.name: ToolbarCloneTip
data.value: Creates a full copy of the selected virtual machine under a new name. The machine must be shut down.

data.name: ToolbarExportTip
data.value: Exports the selected virtual machine as an OVA package, for VMware, VirtualBox or Proxmox. The machine must be shut down.

data.name: ToolbarDeleteTip
data.value: Removes the selected virtual machine from the list, or deletes its files too; you are asked before anything is done

data.name: ToolbarMoreTip
data.value: The commands the window is too narrow to show

data.name: SummaryIsoInsertTip
data.value: Changes the disc in the drive of the running machine

data.name: PlatformCoresPerSocketHeader
data.value: Cores per socket (1 = let QEMU decide)

data.name: PlatformMicrophoneTip
data.value: Gives the guest this PC's microphone. Windows asks for permission the first time.

data.name: PlatformUsbTabletTip
data.value: Absolute pointer: without it the guest's cursor drifts away from the host's

data.name: PlatformBalloonTip
data.value: Lets the host reclaim memory the guest is not using

data.name: PlatformLocalTimeTip
data.value: Expected by Windows; most Linux guests expect UTC

data.name: PlatformSecondIsoHeader
data.value: Second optical drive (virtio-win drivers, for example)

data.name: PlatformExtraArgsPlaceholder
data.value: Appended as is to the end of the command line

data.name: CommandLineHint
data.value: What these settings produce. The control port shown is only indicative: the real one is assigned at start.

data.name: HardwareLocked
data.value: QEMU reads the hardware only when it starts. Shut the machine down to change it.

data.name: BootOrderHint
data.value: The firmware tries the devices in this order. With UEFI it is the only order that counts: a device missing from this list stays invisible to the boot manager.

data.name: DiskCompactTip
data.value: Gives back to this PC the space the disk no longer uses

data.name: DiskLinkedClonePrefix
data.value: Linked clone: holds only what this machine has written, and reads the rest from

data.name: DiskDiscardTip
data.value: Lets the qcow2 image shrink when the guest frees space

data.name: DisksHint
data.value: The format is that of the existing image: changing it here would convert nothing. Detaching does not delete the file.

data.name: NetworkCableDisconnected
data.value: Cable disconnected: the guest sees no network on this adapter

data.name: NetworkNatHint
data.value: With NAT the guest can reach out but nothing gets in: a port forward is the only way to reach it from the host.

data.name: GuestToolsHint
data.value: The guest agent and the guest's tools: shared folders, drag and drop, clipboard, automatic screen size and the network chart depend on them. Checked every time the machine starts.

data.name: GuestToolsTrimTip
data.value: The guest reports the free blocks of its disks; “Compact…” (Hardware, machine shut down) then gives that space back to this PC

data.name: AutoStartHint
data.value: The machine starts when WinQEMU opens, so also at Windows sign-in if WinQEMU starts then (Settings). The delay, counted from when WinQEMU opens, sets the order between machines.

data.name: SnapshotsHint
data.value: Three ways to take a snapshot, each undone differently. Machine shut down: internal snapshot of the disks, undone by bringing them back to that state. Live, disks: each disk gets an overlay; restoring or deleting is done here, with the machine shut down. Live with memory: the machine picks up at the captured moment, but this requires TCG emulation.

data.name: SnapshotsAutoTip
data.value: Taken as the machine starts, while it is still shut down: under WHPX, a snapshot of a running machine can only be deleted once it is shut down. Only those named “Auto …” are deleted beyond the number kept.

data.name: SnapshotsTakeOfflineTip
data.value: Internal snapshot of the disks, machine powered off

data.name: SnapshotsTakeLiveTip
data.value: Machine running: each disk gets an overlay and writes diverge from there. For the guest it is like a power cut.

data.name: SnapshotsTakeMemoryTip
data.value: Machine running under emulation: memory is saved too, so resuming picks up at exactly the same moment.

data.name: SnapshotsRestoreTip
data.value: Machine shut down: brings the disks back to this state

data.name: SnapshotsResumeTip
data.value: Snapshot with memory, machine running: the machine picks up at the captured moment

data.name: SnapshotsLockedHint
data.value: Restoring and deleting require the machine to be shut down: qemu-img cannot touch an image that a running QEMU holds open.

data.name: ConsoleHint
data.value: Click in the console to send keyboard and mouse to the guest. Ctrl+Alt+G releases the mouse. Drag files onto the console to copy them to the guest's desktop.

data.name: ConsoleTypeClipboardTip
data.value: Types the text of this PC's clipboard on the guest's keyboard, for a guest without a shared clipboard (a server's text console, a sign-in screen)

data.name: ConsoleFullScreenTip
data.value: F11 to come back. Esc is not enough: that key goes to the guest.

data.name: FullScreenPowerOffTip
data.value: Turns the machine off immediately, without warning the guest, like pulling the plug

data.name: ResourcesWhenOff
data.value: Processor, memory, disk and network show here while the machine runs.
